name: Gu Yue Clan
uniques: All newly-trained [Rank One Gu Master] units [in all cities] receive the [Moonlight Gu] promotion <in cities with a [Gu Academy]> <when above [0] [Moon Orchid]>
introduction: I am Gu Yue Bo of the Gu Yue clan. Our village has stood on Qing Mao longer than any other; speak, and be brief.
declaringWar: The covenant of the alliance slope does not shelter you. The Gu Yue will settle this themselves.
defeated: Take the village. The spring beneath it will outlast you too.

civilopediaText.text: The Gu Yue clan (古月一族), halfway up Qing Mao Mountain. Its emblem is the Moonlight Gu, bred by a secret method and fed from its own sea of moon orchids. For centuries it ruled the mountain; now the Bai are catching up.

name: Bai Clan
uniques: All newly-trained [Rank One Gu Master] units [in all cities] receive the [Stream Gu] promotion <in cities with a [Gu Academy]>
introduction: The Bai clan bows to no overlord any more. Remember that when you speak.
declaringWar: One spring makes a village; three make a clan. Yours will be the second.
defeated: Centuries under another clan's heel, and it ends like this.

civilopediaText.text: The Bai clan (白家) of the waterfall village on Qing Mao's back slope, second of the three clans and Gu Yue's rising rival, which wants all three springs. Its Gu Masters favour water and ice, and its fighters once brought down a Thunder Crown Wolf.

name: Xiong Clan
uniques: All newly-trained [Rank One Gu Master] units [in all cities] receive the [Bear Strength Gu] promotion <in cities with a [Gu Academy]>
introduction: Xiong village. Count our Gu Masters before you call us weak.
declaringWar: You spent your strength on the wolves. We kept ours.
defeated: Even a bear has to sleep.

civilopediaText.text: The Xiong clan (熊家) on Qing Mao's front slope: the weakest of the three on paper, the most numerous in the field, and righteous like the others. It lets others bleed first and is not above hiring demonic muscle.

name: Wu Clan
introduction: Wu Ji of the Wu clan. The Southern Border keeps me busy; state your purpose.
declaringWar: The righteous never strike without a reason. Here is ours.
defeated: Write it down: the Wu fell to you. Few will believe it.

civilopediaText.text: The Wu clan (武家), first among the Southern Border's righteous super clans, seated on Wu Yi Mountain. Its head Wu Ji walks the strength path, but the clan's own strongest tradition is the wind path (风道); its battle stage is the largest in the region.

name: Heavenly Court
introduction: Duke Long of the Heavenly Court. Fate keeps the world in order; we keep Fate.
declaringWar: You have strayed from your fate. The Court will set it right.
defeated: Fate itself was broken here. Remember who broke it.

civilopediaText.text: The Heavenly Court (天庭), founded by Primordial Origin: it guards and repairs Fate Gu and rules the Central Continent through the ancient sects. Only it builds Fate Gu.

name: Huang Jin Family
introduction: The Huang Jin answer to no one on the plains. Speak plainly.
declaringWar: The blood of Giant Sun does not ask permission.
defeated: Scatter us if you can; one Huang Jin line always survives.

civilopediaText.text: The Huang Jin (黄金家族), every bloodline of Giant Sun on the Northern Plains. No Huang Jin line may be wiped out; only they may pass the 88 True Yang Building's trial.

name: Zombie Alliance
uniques: Free [Immortal Zombie] appears <upon losing a [{post-[Rank Five era]} {non-[Advancing]} {non-[Immortal Zombie]}] unit>
Instantly provides [1] [Lifespan Gu] <upon turn start> <every [7] turns> <for every [1] [[post-[Rank Five era]] Units]> <on [Quick] game speed>
Instantly provides [1] [Lifespan Gu] <upon turn start> <every [10] turns> <for every [1] [[post-[Rank Five era]] Units]> <on [Standard] game speed>
Instantly provides [1] [Lifespan Gu] <upon turn start> <every [15] turns> <for every [1] [[post-[Rank Five era]] Units]> <on [Epic] game speed>
Instantly provides [1] [Lifespan Gu] <upon turn start> <every [30] turns> <for every [1] [[post-[Rank Five era]] Units]> <on [Marathon] game speed>
introduction: The Zombie Alliance greets you. We are righteous, of course. Ask anyone still breathing.
declaringWar: Your immortals will keep. Ours never age.
defeated: Dead again. It was bound to happen.

civilopediaText.text: The Zombie Alliance (僵盟): immortal zombies with a righteous face and a secret master. Its immortals never age, and its fallen rise again as zombies.

name: Fang Clan
uniques: [+50]% Production when constructing [Gu House] units [in all cities]
introduction: The Fang clan builds what lasts. What have you built?
declaringWar: Our Gu Houses are already moving. You should have counted them.
defeated: A fortress falls once. Our name will outlast it.

civilopediaText.text: The Fang clan (房家), a righteous Western Desert power unrivalled at building Gu Houses. Gu Houses +50% production; +10% science.
Hairy men (毛民), born refiners who follow whoever refines better than they do. Their friendship is measured in insight.
The mortal villages at the foot of Qing Mao. The mountain clans divide their farmers and hunters among themselves.
The merchant clan of Jia Village (贾家), whose caravans bring a market and a Gu shop up the mountain. Their best Gu go to the highest bidder.
The hairy-men refiners of the Lang Ya Blessed Land (琅琊派), whose land spirit trades Gu.
Spirit Affinity House (灵缘斋), one of the ten great ancient sects of the Central Continent.
Combat Immortal Sect (战仙宗), one of the ten great ancient sects, famed for battle.
The merfolk's court in the Eastern Sea (鲛人王庭).
